question: Among customers who paid more than 20.00 per unit for product ID 5, which client segment had the lowest total consumption in 2012, and by how much did CZK-paying customers in that segment outspend EUR-paying ones in terms of total consumption that year?

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.XCL_016 = 5
      AND t.XCL_017 > 0
      AND CAST(t.XCL_018 AS REAL) / t.XCL_017 > 20.00
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
),
lowest_segment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
currency_difference AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_003 = 'CZK' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_003 = 'EUR' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS czk_minus_eur
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
      AND c.XCL_002 = (SELECT segment FROM lowest_segment)
)
SELECT
    ls.segment,
    cd.czk_minus_eur
FROM lowest_segment AS ls
CROSS JOIN currency_difference AS cd

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.XCL_016 = 5
      AND t.XCL_017 > 0
      AND CAST(t.XCL_018 AS REAL) / t.XCL_017 > 20.00
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
),
lowest_segment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
currency_difference AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_003 = 'CZK' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_003 = 'EUR' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS czk_minus_eur
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
      AND c.XCL_002 = (SELECT segment FROM lowest_segment)
)
SELECT
    ls.segment,
    cd.czk_minus_eur
FROM lowest_segment AS ls
CROSS JOIN currency_difference AS cd

WITH filtered_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_011 AS transaction_date,
        t.XCL_012 AS currency,
        t.XCL_013 AS product_id,
        t.XCL_014 AS customer_id,
        t.XCL_015 AS quantity,
        t.XCL_016 AS unit_price,
        t.XCL_017 AS total_amount,
        t.XCL_018 AS discount
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_013 = 5
      AND t.XCL_016 > 20.00
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2012'
),
customer_segments AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.transaction_date,
        ft.currency,
        ft.customer_id,
        ft.quantity,
        ft.total_amount,
        c.XCL_003 AS client_segment
    FROM filtered_transactions ft
    JOIN customers c ON ft.customer_id = c.XCL_001
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.client_segment,
        SUM(cs.quantity) AS total_consumption
    FROM customer_segments cs
    GROUP BY cs.client_segment
),
lowest_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        client_segment,
        total_consumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
currency_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.currency,
        SUM(cs.quantity) AS total_consumption
    FROM customer_segments cs
    WHERE cs.client_segment = (SELECT client_segment FROM lowest_segment)
    GROUP BY cs.currency
)
SELECT 
    ls.client_segment,
    (SELECT total_consumption FROM currency_consumption WHERE currency = 'CZK') - 
    (SELECT total_consumption FROM currency_consumption WHERE currency = 'EUR') AS czk_eur_difference
FROM lowest_segment ls

    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
      AND c.XCL_002 = (SELECT segment FROM lowest_segment)
)
SELECT
    ls.segment,
    cd.czk_minus_eur
FROM lowest_segment AS ls
CROSS JOIN currency_difference AS cd

eligibility_lowering.pre_lowering_sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.XCL_016 = 5
      AND t.XCL_017 > 0
      AND CAST(t.XCL_018 AS REAL) / t.XCL_017 > 20.00
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
),
lowest_segment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM segment_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
currency_difference AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_003 = 'CZK' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_003 = 'EUR' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS czk_minus_eur
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
      AND c.XCL_002 = (SELECT segment FROM lowest_segment)
)
SELECT
    ls.segment,
    cd.czk_minus_eur
FROM lowest_segment AS ls
CROSS JOIN currency_difference AS cd
